items.title: Postman: pre-request script
items.body:
pm.variables.set("email", `user${Date.now()}@example.com`);
pm.environment.set("timestamp", new Date().toISOString());

items.title: Run a Postman collection from the CLI (Newman)
items.body:
npm install -g newman
newman run collection.json -e environment.json --reporters cli,junit
items.description: Use in CI.

items.title: curl: status code only
items.body: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.example.com/health
items.description: Quick assertion in a shell script.

items.title: Auth test: no token
items.body: curl -i https://api.example.com/me
items.description: Protected endpoints must refuse anonymous requests (expect 401).

items.title: Auth test: invalid and expired token
items.body:
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer invalid.token.value" https://api.example.com/me
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer {{expired_token}}" https://api.example.com/me
items.description: Expect 401 for both; never 200 or 500.

items.title: Auth test: wrong role
items.body: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer {{user_token}}" https://api.example.com/admin/users
items.description: A normal user must get 403 on admin endpoints.

items.title: Auth test: access another user's object
items.body: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token_of_user_a}}" https://api.example.com/orders/{{order_id_of_user_b}}
items.description: Change the id in the URL; expect 403 or 404 (insecure direct object reference check).

items.title: Negative-test checklist for an endpoint
items.body:
[ ] Missing required field -> 400/422 with a clear message
[ ] Wrong type (string for number, object for array)
[ ] Null, empty string and empty body
[ ] Value too long / too large / out of range
[ ] Unknown extra fields are ignored or rejected consistently
[ ] Invalid JSON body -> 400, not 500
[ ] Wrong Content-Type header -> 415
[ ] Wrong HTTP method -> 405
[ ] Non-existent id -> 404
[ ] Duplicate create -> 409 or a clear validation error
[ ] No/invalid/expired auth -> 401; insufficient rights -> 403
[ ] Oversized payload is rejected
[ ] Errors never expose stack traces or SQL
items.description: What to try on every API endpoint.

items.title: Positive/happy-path checklist
items.body:
[ ] Correct status code (200/201/204)
[ ] Response body matches the documented schema and types
[ ] Required headers present (Content-Type, Location after create)
[ ] Created resource can be fetched afterwards
[ ] Update changes only the intended fields
[ ] Delete removes it (subsequent GET is 404)
[ ] Pagination, sorting and filtering return correct results
[ ] Response time within the agreed limit
items.description: Verify the correct behaviour before the edge cases.

items.title: Pagination test
items.body:
curl -s "https://api.example.com/items?page=1&limit=10" | jq '.results | length'
curl -s "https://api.example.com/items?page=999&limit=10" | jq .      # empty page, not an error
curl -s "https://api.example.com/items?limit=100000" | jq .          # limit must be capped
items.description: Walk pages and check counts and no duplicates.

items.title: Idempotency test
items.body:
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"name":"x"}' https://api.example.com/items/1
done; echo
items.description: Repeating PUT/DELETE gives the same result; repeating POST should not duplicate.

items.title: Rate limit test
items.body:
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " https://api.example.com/login
done; echo
items.description: Send a burst and watch for 429 and Retry-After.

items.title: CORS preflight test
items.body:
curl -i -X OPTIONS https://api.example.com/items \
  -H "Origin: https://app.example.com" \
  -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST" \
  -H "Access-Control-Request-Headers: content-type"
items.description: The browser sends OPTIONS first; check the response headers.

items.title: pytest + requests API test
items.body:
import requests

BASE = "https://api.example.com"

def test_create_and_get_item():
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/items", json={"name": "demo"}, timeout=10)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    item_id = r.json()["id"]

    r = requests.get(f"{BASE}/items/{item_id}", timeout=10)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["name"] == "demo"
items.description: Simple automated API check.

items.title: Check a response with jq
items.body:
curl -s https://api.example.com/items/1 | jq -e '.id == 1 and (.name | length > 0)'
# jq -e exits non-zero if the result is false/null, so it works in CI scripts
items.description: Assert fields from the shell.

items.title: Inject auth header in every request (HTTPie)
items.body:
http GET https://api.example.com/items "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}"
http POST https://api.example.com/items name=demo price:=9.99
items.description: Alternative to curl with readable syntax.

items.title: API contract fields to document
items.body:
Method + path, purpose, auth required, request params/body (types, required, limits),
success response (status + schema + example), error responses (status + body),
rate limits, pagination, versioning, idempotency.
items.description: What a good endpoint spec lists.
